meta_description: Plain-language explainers about Australian systems — Medicare, Centrelink, citizenship and more.

hero.title: Systems newcomers ask about
hero.lead: Short bilingual overviews of how parts of Australia work. These are starting points — not legal or financial advice.
hero.lead_si: Australiaේ කොටස් work වන ආකාරය පිළිබඳ short bilingual overviews. Starting points — legal හෝ financial advice නොවේ.

topics.title: Medicare

topics.title: Centrelink

my_thoughts.title: My thoughts
my_thoughts.body: Official sites are accurate but dense. These pages aim to translate structure — who does what, and which form to open first — before you dive into the fine print.
my_thoughts.body_si: Official sites accurate නමුත් dense. Fine print dive කිරීමට පෙර structure translate කිරීම — who does what, first form කුමක් — මෙම pages aim.
